FORT ST. JOHN, British Columbia - TheNewswire - September 2, 2026 - A.C.L. Construction Ltd. (TSXV: ACL; OTCQB: AACLF; FSE: A3L0) (the "Company" or "A.C.L."), a leading provider of civil construction services, project management, general construction and underground utilities in the Peace Region of British Columbia, announces that Jason Baybutt has been appointed Chief Financial Officer (“CFO”), effective September 1, 2026. Mr Baybutt succeeds Jeff Wagner who stepped down as CFO of the Company. The appointment remains subject to the acceptance of the TSX Venture Exchange Mr. Wagner will continue to assist the Company through 1006098 B.C. Ltd dba PubCo Reporting (“PubCo”) until the end of October 2026 to support an orderly transition and the completion of the Company’s upcoming annual and interim financial reporting obligations.

Mr. Baybutt has been providing fractional CFO and accounting services through PubCo since September 2014. Mr. Wagner provided CFO services to A.C.L. through PubCo. Mr. Baybutt has over 15 years of experience providing C-level consulting and capital market advisory services with both private and public companies located in North America, Europe and Asia. In addition to financial, operational, and strategic advisory experience, his expertise includes the financial complexities associated with derivatives, reverse mergers, business combinations and acquisitions.

"On behalf of the A.C.L. team, I want to extend our sincere thanks to Jeff for his dedication and many contributions to the Company and wish him success in his future endeavours,” said John McPherson, Chief Executive Officer and a director of A.C.L. “I also want to express appreciation for PubCo’s continued service and welcome Jason to our senior leadership team. We look forward to working with him to achieve our corporate goals,” added Mr. McPherson.
About A.C.L. Construction Ltd.

A.C.L. Construction is a civil construction company headquartered in Northeastern British Columbia. The company specializes in the infrastructure services that keep Western Canada and the Territories resource sector operational. The Company delivers large-scale earthworks, underground utility installations and tie-ins, oilfield road construction and maintenance, project management, and remediation and reclamation services across some of the region’s most demanding and remote environments.
The Company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange
, the OTCQB (OTCQB: AACLF) and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FSE: A3LO). For more information, visit http://aclconstructionltd.com
